pages.title: Anti-Star Black Market
pages.text: The Anti-Star black market follows merchant_shops.json#inverse_star_black_market and uses the existing market system. It adds no separate black-market UI, reputation screen, contraband loader, or network packet, and trades in low-grade metal spirit stones.

pages.title: Current Stock
pages.text: Available listings are demon_core_mid, demon_heart_pill, and recipe_demon_heart. They currently reuse a beast core, a low-tier mind-clearing pill, and a Qingxin Pill jade-slip formula as their item forms, priced at 90, 180, and 350 low-grade metal spirit stones. Default restock time is 48000 ticks.

pages.title: Planned Stock
pages.text: stolen_jade_slip, island_deed_gray, contraband_spirit_stone, pirate_loot_bundle, Anti-Star contact tokens, secret orders, and smuggling bundles still require reputation, contraband risk, quests, and NPC support. They are not being forced onto generic substitute items.
